page: Microsoft Azure DC2eds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the DCEDV6 server family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This server type includes 118 GB of local storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any GPU accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. Additionally, it does not provide any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC2eds_v6 offers a balanced entry-point configuration within its hardware class, combining dedicated compute resources with local storage. However, the 8.0 GB memory capacity may limit its capability for memory-intensive enterprise databases. This server is best suited for lightweight database workloads, small-scale web serving, development environments, and basic data processing tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and local disk space.
